mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.0% in 20d forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% by more than 0.3 percentage points within one month signals an accelerating economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to recession fears.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 1 month, the 5d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, the 20d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 245), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 245, the 20d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and strong corporate output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above 100, the 60d forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units within one month signals a contraction in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the broader economy faces headwinds.
failure_condition: When HOUST falls below 1200.0, the 5d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth prospects weaken.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, the 20d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 17000), the economy approaches full capacity, leading to inflationary pressures and potential Federal Reserve tightening, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 > 17000, the 60d forward returns are positive in >60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.
